overview: Aon, 54, a cartoonist once famous for his work "Kittima, the Magical Girl of the Enchanted City," is facing a vulnerable period in his life. His career is failing, his health is declining, and his relationship with his 55-year-old marketing professional, Jira, is showing signs of nearing a dead end. The days of laughter have gradually faded, and accumulated stress is causing Aon insomnia. A fortune teller even predicted that this year would be a year of "breakup" in his life.
title: Hard Nights

overview: Back in high school, gloomy Tong fell for ray-of-sunshine Fah, with his radiant smile and the way he made Tong feel safe and worthy of love. Today, the life they share in their rented apartment is intimate, soft yet sharp, uncomplicated, with Fah always there waiting for him when he gets home. However, something lingers between them that remains unspoken. There's an evident fear abiding in Tong, and one day, Fah says, "Are you really so scared of me, Tong? That's odd. You didn't seem nearly so afraid when you dumped my corpse in the water."
title: Paint You on My Bed Sheet

overview: Fresh out of prison and low on options, two women run a fumigation business — until a shady client pulls them back into the life they fought to escape.
title: El Tiempo de las Moscas

overview: Five Brazilian women, each at a different stage of life and love, travel to South Korea and meet their crushes in this K-drama-inspired reality show.
title: Meu Namorado Coreano

overview: Anthony Edwards, the superstar guard for the NBA's Minnesota Timberwolves, is all business. On the court or off, he's ready to challenge whoever, whenever. Perhaps he's crazy or maybe he's a genius, but Edwards believes he can challenge the world's most elite athletes and biggest celebrities in any competition imaginable - and believes he can win. For him, competition is Serious Business.
title: Serious Business with Anthony Edwards

overview: On Jimmy Houston Outdoors Jimmy Houston visits unique locations and shares his fishing knowledge.
title: Jimmy Houston Outdoors

overview: Highlights from the event, which featured eight stages including two runs of Moll's Gap.
title: Killarney Historic Rally

overview: While Shin Yi Rang dreams of joining a prestigious law firm, he's constantly rejected due to his father's criminal past. Undeterred, he "borrows" money from his mother and opens up his own law firm in a building formerly owned by a shaman. His life and career take a supernatural turn after incense he found in a desk drawer gifts him with the ability to communicate with – and be possessed by – ghosts. With unexpected help from elite lawyer Han Na Hyun, Yi Rang is able to get justice for his first ghostly client, although she's reluctant to admit that spirits are truly speaking to Yi Rang. As their peculiar partnership continues to develop, Yi Rang and Na Hyun find themselves growing closer in more ways than one, all while helping lingering spirits get the closure they need to pass on.
title: Phantom Lawyer

overview: Straight-A student Masha dreams of winning a gold medal, but her love for the romantic Zhenya stands in her way.
title: Четыре четверти

overview: Paulina and Adrián declaring their love and willing to go against their families in order to be happy. Paulina is the daughter of Gonzalo Murat, a rich hotel businessman who does not accept her courtship because he considers that Adrián is not at the social level that they have. However, Paulina is really in love and this doesn't matter to her.
title: A Que No Me Dejas

overview: The story revolves around two intertwined couples navigating love, betrayal, and hidden secrets in a tale of intrigue and redemption.[4]David Genovés, a young man from a wealthy family, falls deeply in love with Gabriela Guillén, but their relationship is threatened by a dark secret shared between Gabriela's father, Fausto, and David's father, Mario Genovés, involving illicit business and a hidden tunnel.[4]Meanwhile, Juan José Victoria, who has spent 11 years in prison for a crime he did not commit, seeks justice and rekindles a romance with Alejandra Balmori, a successful architect from an affluent background, amid rivalries and family conflicts.
title: La Verdad Oculta

overview: Set in the late colonial era of 18th-century Panama and Mexico, Alborada is a historical telenovela centered on a young woman's struggle for justice and true love amidst social rigidities.
title: Alborada

overview: Cristina is a beautiful young woman with a powerful father. She falls in love with a simple worker at her hacienda and gets pregnant. Her father does everything he can to separate the lovers and gives the child to Raquel, a maid at the hacienda. Years pass and a blind Cristina is married to a powerful Federico, her daughter Maria del Carmen a beautiful woman. A young doctor by the name of Jose Manuel arrives to town and catches Maria del Carmens attention. But Federico, Jose Manuels uncle, is also infatuated with the young girl and does everything in his power to separate them.
title: Abrazame Muy Fuerte

overview: A young medical representative struggles against the pharma game, masters it and eventually fights against it.
title: Pharma

overview: Federation Angler TV highlights various national fishing tournaments featuring a range of anglers from Grassroots to Tournament Pros. The best Bass and Walleye are sought out every week in some of the most popular fisheries this country has to offer.
title: Federation Angler TV

overview: Amarte es mi pecado follows the dramatic transformation of an innocent young woman into a hardened, vengeful socialite after a series of tragic betrayals
title: Amarte Es Mi Pecado

overview: Follow Halil Ibrahim as he seeks revenge for the death of the love of his life. His plans are derailed when he meets Zeynep from the Leto family.
title: Amar sin límites

overview: Not a rom-com, but a friend-com. Will Aster and Celie's friendship survive the nine parties and their accompanying hangovers?
title: 9 feestjes voor de kater

overview: Four girlfriends from different social classes experience what's it like being 20 - working and studying, falling in love, getting drugs or fighting a terminal illness.
title: Amigas y rivales

overview: The romance between Tomás and Gabriela blossoms at an artisan fair, unaware of their families' connection: years earlier, their parents experienced an impossible love. During the fair, Gabriela learns that her mother has had an accident and must return home, while Tomás receives the news of his father's death. At the funeral, they discover that their parents were involved in the same accident—one that appears to have been intentional. Driven by grief and a desire for justice, Tomás moves to Todos Los Santos to uncover the truth and seek revenge on Leonor, Gabriela's grandmother, whom he suspects is responsible. Now, family secrets and the past will test their love, forcing them to confront forces that could tear them apart forever.
title: Amor Amargo

overview: Abril and Max have nothing in common. She loves living in her small town and working on the fields. He has overlooked his roots and lives happily in a first world country.It would be difficult for these two people to fall in love, but for various reasons their lives begin to change radically until they come together amidst the loneliness and disappointment in which their respective partners have left them. Debra, Max's wife, divorces because she can't get used to the country where her parents moved years ago. On the other hand, Bruno, Abril's husband, abandons her because he dreams of living in the United States and making dollars to get ahead.
title: Amor Dividido

overview: Each week, Yamaha Whitetail Diaries brings viewers the best whitetail deer hunting stories from across the nation. Already noted as one ot the highest rated deer hunting programs on air today, these stories highlight North America's most sought after game animal , the whitetail deer. This series incorporates product features, story telling,insight about tactics, and safety messages while using a mix of talent to ensure quality programming.
title: Yamaha Whitetail Diaries

overview: Amores de Mercado tells the story of Fernando, an ambitious man who driven by greed will do the unimaginable to his own family, Lucía, a woman in search of her husband, and Diego, an athlete who feels defeated by life. Lucia and Diego will meet and find a reason to love again and start over in life, however, destiny will put them to the test. This is a story of second chances and how love can save us when everything else is lost.
title: Amores de Mercado

overview: Join us on Fridays for Bit City, Spud Hut, and more! Become a member for extra content we had to cut!
title: Smosh

overview: Julia Montaño is the daughter of Don Julio Montaño, a wealthy landowner in the Yucatán Peninsula. She is a beautiful, strong-willed and sometimes arrogant woman, who flouts her father's will and the customs of their small town by spending her days herding cattle and overseeing the management of her father's ranch. She has two siblings - Álvaro, a dissipated young man who spends the majority of his time chasing girls and getting drunk, and Soledad, a beautiful and ingenuous young girl who falls in love with Gabriel Durán, the handsome gamester and ex-lover of their greedy step-mother Cassandra, who moves to San Gaspar after winning the hacienda of Don Ignacio Andrade, Julio's closest friend, in a poker game. Don Ignacio's son, Francisco, has been in love with Julia, but after discovering that he has become involved with the town harlot, Eva, spurns him for Gabriel. Julia doesn't let herself be domesticated by anyone, but despite all the disagreements, she has to admit she is deeply in love with Gabriel. Nevertheless, after she catches him cheating her with Eva, Julia declines his marriage proposal. Although she claims to utterly hate him, she eventually accepts to marry him, only to save her family's fortune that Don Julio foolishly lost in a bet with Gabriel. At first their marriage is full of fights and hateful words as Julia is determined to make Gabriel pay for his faults, but her heart softens after giving birth to their son. Things seem to look up for them and they start living as a normal couple, but the real troubles are yet to come.
title: Apuesta Por Un Amor

overview: Montserrat is a girl who lives with her wealthy parents who adore her and Juan José, her boyfriend, loves her very much. Ingrid envies everything that makes her cousin Montserrat happy and decides to destroy her love with Juan José.
title: Bajo las Riendas del Amor

overview: Barrera de Amor revolves around María Teresa "Maité" Galván, a humble and hardworking young woman, who lives in the town of Santa María, Aguascalientes, and works at her aunt's fonda. She becomes engaged to Luis Antonio Romero, a widowed veterinarian and single father, but their romance is shattered when Maité is assaulted by the wealthy and arrogant Adolfo Valladolid, resulting in her pregnancy and a cascade of dramatic conflicts involving the powerful Valladolid family.
title: Barrera de Amor

overview: "Camelia La Texana" is the story of a naïve and beautiful young woman who tries to escape her destiny. The story begins in the 1970s when young Camelia and her mother flee one of Mexico's most dangerous capos, Don Antonio. Camelia's beauty attracts a lot of attention – jealousy from other women and infatuation on the part of many men, who fall powerless at her feet. Her mother tries to protect her from the fate that pursues her, but as she sets off in search of adventure Camelia meets the man who will be the love of her life, and also her betrayer: Emilio Varela. Emilio promises Camelia the moon and the stars, but instead he breaks her heart.
title: Camelia, La Texana

overview: Camaleones is the story of Valentina and Sebastián, who are both skilled thieves. They are united when a man they call "El Amo" forces them to commit crimes in order to protect their loved ones, who are in jail. El Amo wants to outwit Augusto Ponce de León, a corrupt police chief who is in charge of the "Chameleon" case, which he has to solve if he wants to reach a position in politics and gain more and more power. Valentina and Sebastián pose as prefect and art history teacher, respectively, at San Bartolomé School, where Augusto and Francisca, his wife, are the directors and owners; it is there where their daughter Solange studies. The school's gardener, Leónidas, is an undercover policeman who plans to put Augusto in jail for his crimes and the death of his son, since Augusto threw him off a building and made everyone believe that he had committed suicide. Leónidas develops friendships with Valentina, Sebastian, Solange and Ulises, and from the basement of the school he is planning revenge against Augusto for pretending to be something he is not. Ironically, all the main characters pretend to be someone else, hence the name Chameleons.
title: Camaleones

overview: CLAP stands for "el Comité de la Escuela de Artes", the Art School. It was founded by retired actress Ofelia because long time ago she didn't support her own daughter when she wanted to follow in her footsteps; now she's trying to correct this mistake by supporting young talent. This year, childhood friends Valentinna, Montserrat, and Helena have come to CLAP, although Helena's mother is against it. Montserrat's brother Tomas, who is in love with Helena, goes with them. In Mexico City they meet Fabricio, who lives in the same hotel and wants to study at CLAP; he never talks about his past or parents. There is also Juan Pablo, who has lived with Padre Constantino since he was abandoned in the church; he directs the church choir, and he will fall in love with Valentina. There are many other personages and students of CLAP. This is basically another teen novela about their problems, love, and friendship.
title: Clap!... El lugar de tus sueños

overview: The story is set in Acapulco, Mexico, in an exclusive gated community where a diverse group of young neighbors and friends lives. The series follows their intertwined lives, focusing on romance, friendship, family conflicts, and personal struggles. Like many Televisa youth dramas, it blends love, suspense, and emotional challenges while exploring the characters' dreams and relationships.
title: Código postal

overview: Blitz TV is a show that takes big game hunting to the extreme. Join Host and NFL Pro-Bowl Star Trent Cole and Richie Elam as they guide you on an all-out hunting Blitz across North America along with the Blitz TV Field Staff. So come along and feel the Blitz with us as we pursue our passion.
title: Blitz TV

overview: Jesus and his two siblings are forcefully split up and given up for adoption following the sudden death of their father. When Jesus grows up, he goes on a mission to find his younger brothers and successfully reunites them. Together, before their father's grave, they vow to destroy Augusto Ruiz Montalvo, the man behind their father's death who took everything from them. Their vengeance will be aimed at Augusto's three daughters without suspecting that love will hinder the promise they made.
title: Corazón Guerrero

overview: Ángela, an innocent nurse and medical student from a remote town, is seduced by Álvaro, an ambitious young man, who marries her and leaves her to return to the city and trickily remarry Samanta Vega, the daughter of his boss. in a marriage of convenience. Ángela goes to look for him in Mexico City, discovers the deceit, and they divorce; she meets Leonardo, a young doctor who falls in love with her and becomes her protector.
title: Contigo Sí

overview: Cannon and Ball's Casino brings the comedy duo Tommy Cannon and Bobby Ball to a casino-themed studio where humour, music and light-hearted competition meet. Each episode mixes sketches and guest performances with quiz rounds for couples hoping to win prizes, all delivered with the duo's trademark cheeky warmth and playful chaos.
title: Cannon and Ball's Casino

overview: Thrilling WWII stories of Captain Ernest Krause inspired by actual events.
title: Greyhound

overview: Renata, a spirited woman, is treated cruelly by her mother and sister. Falling in love with Jerónimo changes her life for the better, but his misguided quest to avenge his brother's death jeopardizes their relationship.
title: Cuando me enamoro

overview: Valentina dreams of making it in the world of fashion. She lives with her father and her sister, Nora, whom she regards as her best friend, but Nora is deeply jealous of her. Valentina is Ricardo's girlfriend, who only intends to use her to steal her father's money. A terrible accident takes away what Valentina loves the most: her fiancé and her father. Completely devastated, the sisters move to the city where they meet Claudio. Nora immediately tries to seduce him, but he and Valentina have fallen in love. Both will have to fight for their love and defeat all the challenges ahead of them.
title: Diseñando tu amor

overview: The plot follows wealthy landowner Álvaro Montellano, who, deceived by a forged letter suggesting his daughter Alina is not his biological child, banishes her and her mother Soledad to live as outcasts in the wilderness. Alina, unaware of her true parentage, falls in love with the honorable military officer Emilio Valtierra, but their romance is thwarted by misunderstandings, including Emilio being led to believe Alina has died. As secrets unravel, involving Álvaro's scheming accomplice and Emilio's manipulative former lover, the story explores themes of familial bonds, vengeance, and passionate duels of the heart amid escalating conflicts.
title: Duelo de Pasiones

overview: Hit Man was a short-lived NBC daytime game show from early 1983 that blended trivia with strategy. Contestants first watched brief documentary-style film clips, then faced questions drawn from what they'd just seen — rewarding sharp attention and quick recall rather than general knowledge. Players competed across multiple rounds to "eliminate" opponents by claiming spaces on a game board, with the final winner moving on to a bonus game for a cash prize. Hosted by Peter Tomarken, the show ran on weekdays at 11:30 AM Eastern and packed its competition and quiz elements into a brisk half-hour format.
title: Hit Man

overview: The Greatest Holiday Commercials Countdown is a celebration of the best Holiday commercials from around the world. Brand new for 2015, television personalities Kevin Frazier ("Entertainment Tonight") and Keltie Knight ("The Insider") host this holiday celebration with a countdown of the 12 best holiday commercials ever – one for each of the 12 days of Christmas. In addition to the top 12, the special features other great commercials from both the U.S. and abroad that capture the true spirit of the holiday season – from the heartfelt to the hilarious, from the outstanding to the ridiculous.
title: Greatest Holiday Commercials Countdown

overview: The telenovela tells the story of Jade and Lucas. Jade is a young woman of Arab descent, who is supposed to live with her father's family in Morocco after the death of her mother. Lucas is a young romantic, and son of a powerful businessman. When Lucas is on vacation in Morocco, he meets Jade, and the two of them fall in love. However, cultural differences will not allow them to be together. While they seek ways to realize their love, a pre-written destiny changes their lives forever.
title: El Clon

overview: Beatriz Almazan, a widow with a generous heart, dedicates herself to raising her two children after her husband's death. Her life turns mysterious and terrifying when she meets the powerful millionaire Enrique de Martino, whom she agrees to marry. After moving to De Martino's house, Beatriz discovers that her new husband is a sorcerer who worships a diabolical entity and has resorted to black magic to amass his immense fortune. He will fight for Beatriz's love, only to realize that the curse from which no one can escape is love itself.
title: El Maleficio

overview: The story follows María Liz, a hardworking nurse living in a poor neighborhood in Mexico City. She supports her boyfriend, Marcelo, who is studying engineering but is secretly selfish and ambitious. María Liz's life changes when she meets Sebastián, a wealthy civil engineer who despises the superficial world of his mother, Doña Lucrecia.
title: El Amor No Tiene Precio

overview: Carlota, who, after separating from the person she thought was the love of her life, discovers that the saying "happily ever after" is not always true, but that doesn't mean she can't be happy.
title: Cualqier parecido

overview: El privilegio de amar follows Luciana, a successful fashion designer who is haunted by the decision she made as a young maid to abandon her daughter, Cristina, following a forbidden affair with a seminary student. Two decades later, an adult Cristina enters Luciana's fashion house to pursue a modeling career, leading to a volatile relationship where neither is aware of their biological bond. As Cristina falls in love with Luciana's stepson, Víctor Manuel, and faces sabotage from rivals, the story culminates in the eventual discovery of her true parentage and Luciana's quest for redemption.
title: El privilegio de amar

overview: After her parents die in a car accident, the young and sweet Paloma is taken in by her single aunts. Macarena soon takes a liking to her niece and treats her like a daughter, while Carlota is oppressive, wanting to keep Paloma under her clutches.
title: En nombre del amor

overview: A married couple moves from the big city to their home in a small town after the wife suffers from a lung problem. However, the presence of her husband's brothers at their home leads to complications.
title: En tierras salvajes

overview: Lisa and Tanya fall in love with their classmate Paul, which causes a rift between them. However, when a pregnant Tanya is killed before her wedding, Paul takes Lisa's help to overcome the trauma.
title: Entre el amor y el odio

overview: The Hollywood Christmas Parade (formerly the Hollywood Santa Parade or Santa Claus Lane Parade) is an annual parade that takes place on the Sunday after Thanksgiving in the Hollywood community in Los Angeles, California, United States. The parade follows a 3.5-mile route along Sunset Boulevard and features various celebrities among its participants. Beginning in 1928, Hollywood merchants transformed a one-mile stretch of Hollywood Boulevard into "Santa Claus Lane" to boost shopping. Part of the promotion was a daily parade featuring Santa Claus and a film star. Originally called the Santa Claus Lane Parade, the inaugural event featured only Santa Claus and the actress Jeanette Loff. The parade continued to grow in scale with the help of local businesses and the community. In 1931 Santa Claus rode a truck-pulled float instead of the reindeer-pulled carriage of previous years. American LegionPost 43 marched with a color guard, drum line and bugle corps. The Parade was suspended from 1942 to 1944 due to World War II, but reopened in 1945 with record attendance. In 1946 Gene Autry rode his horse in the parade and was inspired by the children yelling "Here comes Santa Claus, Here comes Santa Claus," to write the song "Here Comes Santa Claus" along with Oakley Haldeman. Autry would become a perennial Grand Marshal of the parade. The parade continued to grow throughout the 1950s, '60s, and '70s, adding floats, animals, bands and celebrities. By 1978, the parade had been renamed the Hollywood Christmas Parade in order to attract more celebrities, and was broadcast locally on KTLA-TV with the help of Autry and Johnny Grant. This change also coincided with a shift in the parade's scheduling from Thanksgiving Eve to the Sunday after Thanksgiving.
title: Hollywood Christmas Parade

overview: El Juramento follows Santiago de Landeros as he seeks to avenge his brother Diego's suicide by finding the woman who broke his heart, known only by a necklace and the initial "A". His quest leads him to the Robles Conde family, where the manipulative Alma deceives him into believing her virtuous cousin, Andrea, is the culprit. Driven by his oath of revenge, Santiago seduces and marries Andrea with the intention of making her life a living hell at his remote hacienda, only to find himself falling deeply in love with her as she desperately tries to prove her innocence. The truth eventually emerges that Alma was the real "gold-digger" who drove Diego to his death, forcing Santiago to beg for Andrea's forgiveness and fight to save their marriage from further external schemes.
title: El Juramento

overview: Adapted from the American format, Hitman is a memory-based quiz show in which Nick Owen guides contestants through a series of rounds built around specially-produced filmed inserts. After watching short feature clips on a range of topics, players must recall specific details and answer questions under pressure, with accuracy and attention to detail deciding who advances to the final game and who leaves empty-handed.
title: Hitman

overview: Two people meet on the streets of the city, London. Later, they develop an unlikely friendship. Will they manage to be friends for long?
title: El derecho de nacer

overview: Good vibes, great guests, glorious fringe. Your weekly dose of Claudia‑powered joy, as she has a chat with Hollywood stars, the best of British and her gorgeous studio audience.
title: The Claudia Winkleman Show

overview: Dante Ferrer has just learned that he will soon die as he is terminally ill, so he decides to gather the whole family together and feels the urge to sort out his affairs and spend the rest of his life in his family's company. Upon reuniting with the Ferrer family, passions run wild, mostly due to Alexa and Gabriel's unexpected forbidden romance and their discovery that the illicit counterfeiting of banknotes lies behind the family's olive oil production business.
title: Fuego Ardiente

overview: Fuego en la Sangre is about the Reyes brothers (Juan, Oscar, Franco) who seek to avenge the death of their sister Libia, falling in love with the Elizondo sisters in the process, unleashing a war of passions, secrets, and family conflicts on a ranch controlled by an evil mother and son-in-law, transforming their revenge into forbidden love.
title: Fuego en la Sangre

overview: Four women, Lorena, Lisset, Frida, and Montse, are serving sentences in prison. Lorena, unjustly accused, joins a mass escape led by Lisset. Together, they take refuge in a bar, facing a life on the run. With the help of lawyer Alejandro Castillo and her companions, Lorena seeks to clear her name and find the true culprit, while navigating a path filled with love and betrayal in her quest for justice.
title: Fugitivas

overview: Join Shayne Topp (short), Amanda Lehan-Canto (tall), and a rotating Smosh friend as we discuss what's on our minds, what we've found on the internet, and other dumb ideas we're cooking up.
title: Smosh Mouth

overview: The story of three families that win a million-dollar prize. The first family, Brenda, Tony, and their younger brother, yearn to break free from their cruel stepmother. However, being underage, they can't claim the prize themselves. The second family, single mother Miranda and her son Diego, dreams of buying a house and independent. The third family, the Pérezes, led by Nacho, has a special bond with the Teporingos Neza soccer team and aims to take them to the premier division. Yet, all face the greed of a corrupt financial advisor Dante Ferrer. Money transforms their lives, unveiling unexpected challenges. As they strive to overcome these obstacles, they discover that love and unity are vital for regaining happiness amid fortune and adversity.
title: Golpe de Suerte

overview: Heridas de Amor revolves around Miranda San Llorente, a modern, wealthy young woman whose destiny is tragically intertwined with forbidden love and family drama when her father is murdered and she is forced into a marriage of convenience with a man who hates her, unleashing tumultuous passion, revenge, and secrets on a ranch as she discovers painful truths about her past and true love.
title: Heridas de Amor

overview: The NFL Network is partnering with show-business luminaries like Tim McGraw and Jeremy Renner for a new documentary series called The Timeline that will highlight pivotal moments and teams in National Football League history, including the complicated relationship between Brett Favre and the Green Bay Packers, the merger between the National Football League and the American Football League, and the Giants' momentous decision to move from New York City to New Jersey. George Clooney's Smokehouse Pictures will co-produce an episode that tells the story of how a Los Angeles reporter got a crude tape of Super Bowl XIV to U.S. hostages held in Tehran in 1980.
title: The Timeline

overview: In Mazatlán, Elena, an illegitimate daughter of a rich man, falls for poor Ulises. Despite obstacles, their love endures as she becomes a biologist and he, a sailor. Reuniting years later, jealous rivals try to keep them apart.
title: Huracán

overview: A naive young Mexican woman, Florecita, journeys to Miami with her family, facing hardships like her grandmother's death in the desert, only to find her father is an alcoholic, all while falling in love with the charming Julio Alberto, a man who becomes entangled in her dramatic new life amidst secrets and family struggles in the U.S..
title: Inocente de Ti

overview: Juro que te amo is a Mexican telenovela about the Madrigal family, who lose their fortune and face social hypocrisy, forcing the young protagonist, Violeta, to fight against adversity and heartbreak with the ambitious Max, while a more noble man, José María, vies for her heart, all while she moves to the capital and deals with humiliation and family secrets, learning that love and money are not the same thing.
title: Juro que Te Amo

overview: La Esposa Virgen focuses on Virginia, a young woman who, in order to protect her family and fulfill a promise, marries a wealthy landowner, Fernando, as a virgin. He despises her and accuses her of being an adventuress, unleashing a drama of passion, deception, and redemption amid intrigues over his fortune, where true love will slowly blossom against all odds.
title: La Esposa Virgen

overview: How a strong ambitious streak propels Meghan Markle onto the global stage and on a collision course with the British royal family - from her role in the hit legal drama Suits to a date that changes everything.
title: Meghan

overview: When Don Severiano dies, his five adopted children discover they have a "sister" named Sara Del Monte Portillo- Severiano's only biological child conceived from an affair. Sara grew up believing that her father never cared about her. The arrival of the young woman will turn the lives of the Del Monte brother's upside down not only because their inheritance is in danger but also because one of them is strongly attracted to Sara and is engaged to another woman.
title: La Herencía

overview: Gloria Guzmán, a woman who appeared to have it all: a successful career, a cherished son, and a loving family. On what is supposed to be the happiest day of her life, marrying the father of her son, the celebration turns into tragedy when a group of hitmen bursts into the ceremony and kills her groom. Gloria not only loses her great love, but her family also turns their back on her, the government seizes all her assets, the media points fingers at her, and her husband's enemies pursue her, demanding payment for dirty deals she was unaware of. In her fight for survival, she is mentored by top crime bosses, whom she must win over by using her two most dangerous weapons: her intelligence and her beauty.
title: La Jefa

overview: In the wealthy London suburb of Hampstead, residents are scammed out of a million pounds by a prolific fraudster who masquerades as a shaman.
title: The Million Pound Shaman Scam

overview: This is the story of an exemplary mother, with the HEART OF A CHAMPION, who always fights for her own against long odds and external challenges. She will not rest until her son is a soccer star.
title: La Jefa del Campeón

overview: NFL Network gets an early start on Sunday's action with NFL GameDay First the day's first pregame show. Host Melissa Stark, co-host/analyst Shaun O'Hara and analyst Michael Robinson -- plus frequent guest analysts -- present the latest news reports from around the league and comprehensive break downs of each matchup. The two-hour show leads viewers into "NFL GameDay Morning" to continue the network's wall-to-wall Sunday coverage of the NFL.
title: NFL GameDay First

overview: Professional con artist, Andrea, draws on her beauty, intelligence and charm to dupe her victims. She sets up a master plan to trick Tyler, an American millionaire searching for his birth mother. Andrea approaches him claiming to be his sister and telling him his real mother is eager to see him, and so is his whole family. Things become complicated as the "family" members experience crises compromising the charade. Andrea's wit helps her bridge such events, but as she falls in love with her victim, Tyler Somers, she is confronted with the dilemma of either giving up on her plan or on her love.
title: La Mexicana y El Güero

overview: The story of Acacia Benavente, a girl who loses her father Alonso in an accident while he was riding his horse. When her mother Cristina finds love again after being widowed for just a year, Acacia is enraged and leaves the ranch in which they live in to go live with her grandparents. She returns 12 years later, now a stunningly beautiful young woman and without her realizing it, awakens in Esteban, her stepfather, a deep and passionate desire.
title: La Malquerida

overview: On a dark, stormy night, Bernarda, Leopoldo Guillen's lover, takes her two small daughters, Eugenia and Carlota, to his funeral. Leopold's son, Roman, his wife, and the priest tell them that they are unwelcome at the funeral and Roman throws them out in the mud. Years later, Carlota and Eugenia are attending a university where Carlota studies music and Eugenia studies accounting. Bernarda favors and expects the best out of Eugenia, who is failing school. However, she disdains and expects the worst out of Carlota, whom Bernarda calls "inutil" (good-for-nothing).
title: La Otra

overview: La que no podía amar is about Ana Paula, a young nurse who, to save her brother from prison, marries the crippled millionaire Rogelio Montero, a bitter and temperamental man, finding herself caught up in a marriage of convenience full of drama, pain, and a complicated love that defies her will, while she is torn between her duty and a new love with a handsome engineer named Gustavo, unleashing an intense war of passions and secrets on the estate.
title: La Que No Podía Amar

overview: La Sombra del Pasado tells the story about the forbidden love between Aldonza and Cristóbal, whose rival families violently separate them after a rape, forcing them to fight against hatred, revenge, and ambition for their love to triumph.
title: La Sombra del Pasado

overview: A wronged executive, Marina, seeking refuge and work in a small fishing town, clashes with and falls for the charismatic boat captain Damián, as they fight powerful enemies, including a human trafficking ring, while uncovering secrets about her past and discovering a deep love amidst danger and betrayal
title: La Tempestad

overview: This romantic saga features Hugo de Medina, a handsome, mysterious swordsman, with a reputation as a womanizer. His life crashes around him when he finds he suffers from catalepsy, an incurable condition marked by loss of voluntary motion. The same disease felled his father years before. This dashing young man meets Soledad de Obregon, a gorgeous, refined girl and the two are bound together by sudden passion, though matters are complicated by Hugo's desire to hide his infirmity.[3] As the adoring couple prepares to marry, tragedy strikes again.[4] Hugo's sinister brother, Alcides, who has always been in love with Soledad, betrays him and steals his betrothed. The rest of the telenovela deals with first Hugo's quest for vengeance and then his attempts to regain the trust and love of Soledad.
title: La Traición

overview: Two families, the Santos and the Olmos, face a fight of power, ambitions, selfishness and love. The Santos are provincial family that has a pottery factory with financial problems, which Ramiro Santos (Rogelio Guerra) manages along with his cousin Evaristo Olmos (Joaquín Cordero). However, this business deal finishes due to personal differences, this provokes the rancor and hate of Ramiro, and his family goes into bankruptcy, while Evaristo Olmos achieves an excellent status. When Ramiro dies, his family moves to the capital, hoping for a good fortune. But destiny will set a trap, when Evaristo offers his house for them to live, here his family treat them very bad, with contempt and haughtiness because they are the poor relatives.
title: Los Parientes Pobres

overview: Ride along with the ups and downs of these notorious news anchors who get married as a publicity stunt.
title: Los Exitosos Pérez

overview: When they were children, Julieta and the brothers Pedro and Cristóbal Valencia were friends, but Genaro owner of "The Castle" and the boys' father, pulled them apart. The painter Gabriel Almada takes care of little Julieta when her grandfather dies. They leave the region and over the years she becomes a brilliant doctor. Moved by nostalgia, she decides to return to San Vicente, her hometown, and practice her profession there. Gabriel accompanies her, but their return revives passions from the past. Genaro's hatred towards Gabriel is reborn, because he always knew that the painter was the true love of his wife, Sofía This hatred is shared by Pedro, who once saw Gabriel kissing his mother. Genaro brings his niece, Nadia to "The Castle" with the idea of solving his financial problems through the fortune that the young woman has inherited. On her side, Julieta discovers that her childhood friendship with Pedro has turned into a mature and well-requited love. But they are separated by Nadia, who has set her sights on him. Julieta, alone and hurt, takes refuge in Gabriel, but he has fallen in love with her. Julieta finds herself between two conflicting emotions: her strong passion for Pedro and the peaceful and secure love that Gabriel offers her. Now, Julieta must choose between two loves
title: Laberintos de Pasión

overview: Rich Eisen leads a cast of NFL talent through four hours of pregame hype on NFL GameDay Morning, prepping viewers for the kickoffs of Sunday's games. Joining Eisen are Hall of Famers Marshall Faulk, Michael Irvin and Warren Sapp, Super Bowl champion Kurt Warner, former NFL head coach Steve Mariucci, and special guests each week to break down the matchups. The latest news from around the league, reports from game sites and interviews with players and coaches also are featured, and insider Ian Rapoport provides late-breaking news.
title: NFL GameDay Morning

overview: An intense story of passion, action and drama about two polar opposite individuals who find love in an unexpected place. Gustavo Velasco comes from a crime family that carries out high-end thefts, sharing their pickings with those who need it most a la Robin Hood. Veronica Vega comes from a family that represents law and order, and her determination to carry out that legacy leads her to Gustavo's arrest. Upon their encounter, a strong attraction and overwhelming passion that overlooks all the obstacles lying before them builds, changing their lives forever.
title: Ladrón de Corazónes

overview: Watch the hilarious reactions of real men unexpectedly confronted by totally naked women in the strangest places in this hysterical Playboy series.
title: Playboy's Really Naked Truth

overview: This romantic melodrama features Alejandra Aguirre, a gorgeous, tenacious woman with an amazingly well-preserved body. She grows rice in the rural town of Castellón-and hides a deep, shocking secret. She is a 50-year-old woman with great passion, sensuality, and splendor. Her self-willed intensity puts her in the middle of a rivalry between Leonardo Cisneros and his handsome, daring son Ángel. Both dashing men want to possess this vivacious heroine.
title: Madre Luna

overview: Mañana Es Para Siempre is about Eduardo Cruz, who seeks revenge against the Elizalde family for a tragic past orchestrated by the evil Rebeca (Bárbara Greco), trained by the villain Artemio Bravo, while fighting for his love with Fernanda Elizalde, who is separated from him by Rebeca's intrigues. Eduardo develops a secret identity to infiltrate and destroy his enemies from within, facing deception, blackmail, and forbidden love.
title: Mañana Es Para Siempre

overview: Luisa and Marcelo are a happy couple until her father, Alejandro, is murdered by Zaid, his best friend. Zaid blames Marcelo for the crime and kidnaps him with the help of some guerrillas. Luisa becomes pregnant with Marcelo's child but marries Zaid, who offers her protection and love. Seven years later, Marcelo escapes and returns to Nayarit to reclaim his family and prove his innocence. Zaid will do everything possible to prevent Marcelo from getting close to Luisa and their daughter Natalia, who is the result of her love with Marcelo.
title: Marea de Pasiones

overview: Love blooms between Victoria and Alejandro, set against the backdrop of a tragic and vengeful past. Years ago, Fernando Pérez-Soler orchestrated the persecution of Alejandro's family, resulting in his mother's death and the presumed loss of his newborn cousin. Forced to flee with his aunt Deborah, Alejandro returns twenty-five years later, driven by a thirst for justice. Unaware of the truth, Alejandro falls deeply in love with Victoria, never suspecting that her family is responsible for his suffering. Torn between the need for vengeance and his growing feelings for her, he faces a heart-wrenching decision: carry out his plan for revenge or surrender to the love he's found, all while confronting the painful truth that stands between them.
title: Me Atrevo a Amarte

overview: The Uriarte family faces tensions when Greta, dissatisfied in her marriage, reconnects with a past love, causing family division. Her favoritism towards Bárbara and Pablo creates opposing sides with Fátima and Gonzalo. Bárbara, obsessed with becoming a mother again, falls in love with Daniel, her husband Mario's cousin, leading to betrayal and conflicts. Fátima, the youngest, realizes her engagement to Adrián isn't true love when she meets Sebastián, who steals her heart. These three women confront deep emotional conflicts that test their values, ethics, and priorities, discovering that true love is timeless.
title: Mi Amor Sin Tiempo
